payload.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
payload.body:
## Pull request overview

This PR refactors logging across the monorepo by replacing direct `console.*` usage with centralized `logger.*` calls, introducing a Winston-based backend logger and enforcing a frontend lint rule to prevent regressions.

**Changes:**
- Migrated many frontend and backend call sites from `console.*` to `logger.*`.
- Rebuilt the backend logger (`backend/src/utils/logger.util.ts`) on Winston and removed console “monkey patch” suppression from `backend/src/server.ts`.
- Added a frontend ESLint rule to error on `console.*` usage going forward.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 95 out of 95 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

| frontend/src/pages/Leaderboard.tsx | Replace fetch failure `console.error` with `logger.error` |
| frontend/src/pages/Gallery.tsx | Replace gallery/rating failure `console.error` with `logger.error` |
| frontend/src/main.tsx | Replace missing env var `console.warn` with `logger.warn` |

payload.author: github-actions

payload.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
payload.body:
## Pull request overview This PR introduces a reusable page transition wrapper to add a subtle navigation animation across the frontend layouts, and documents the change in the changelog. **Changes:** - Added a new `PageTransition` component using `framer-motion` (with reduced-motion handling). - Wrapped route content in `RootLayout` and `DashboardLayout` with `PageTransition` to animate on route changes. - Added unit tests for `PageTransition` and updated `CHANGELOG.md`. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 5 out of 5 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | frontend/src/components/layout/root_layout.component.tsx | Wrapes layout children with `PageTransition` to animate route content. | | frontend/src/components/layout/PageTransition.tsx | Adds the new route-keyed transition component (AnimatePresence/motion + reduced motion). | | frontend/src/components/layout/PageTransition.test.tsx | Adds unit tests for `PageTransition`. | | frontend/src/components/dashboard/dashboard_layout.component.tsx | Wraps `` with `PageTransition` for dashboard route transitions. | | CHANGELOG.md | Notes the new navigation transition behavior in Unreleased. |
Suppressed comments (1) **frontend/src/components/layout/PageTransition.tsx:33** * The PR description/issue says “fade-in” on navigation, but using AnimatePresence with `mode="wait"` plus an `exit` variant produces a fade-out before the next route fades in (and can briefly show an empty state). If the intent is fade-in only, drop the `exit` animation and the wait-mode so the incoming page can fade in immediately. ``` ```

## Pull request overview Adds/improves documentation around the frontend emotion-analysis utilities and introduces a helper to compute average emotion values across scenes. **Changes:** - Restores/updates `EmotionPoint` and `analyzeEmotionJourney` with JSDoc for clearer intent/usage. - Adds `computeAverageEmotion(points)` to compute per-emotion averages across a set of scenes.
Suppressed comments (1) **frontend/src/utils/emotionAnalyzer.ts:45** * The computeAverageEmotion JSDoc describes an "average across all scenes" but doesn’t mention that the returned point is an aggregate with `scene: 0`, and that averages can be fractional. Documenting this avoids accidental use of the returned value as a real scene in UI components (e.g., XAxis based on `scene`). ``` /** * Computes the average emotion scores across all scenes in an emotional journey. * * @param points - An array of EmotionPoint objects representing the emotional journey. * @returns A single EmotionPoint object containing the average scores for each emotion. ```

## Pull request overview This PR removes `React.FC` usage from `SSProfile` (and also `SSButton`) and introduces a shared frontend `logger` wrapper to replace direct `console.*` calls across several hooks/components; it additionally changes autosave network behavior and deletes a debounced-search hook module. **Changes:** - Refactor `SSProfile` and `SSButton` away from `React.FC` to explicit function component typing. - Replace `console.*` usage with a centralized `logger` in multiple hooks/components. - Modify autosave networking logic and delete `frontend/src/hooks/global.ts` (which previously exported `useDebounced`). ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 9 out of 9 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | frontend/src/hooks/useVoiceFavorites.ts | Switches localStorage error logging from `console.error` to `logger.error`. | | frontend/src/hooks/useRecentPrompts.ts | Adds `logger` error reporting for localStorage persist/parse failures. | | frontend/src/hooks/useNotifications.ts | Replaces `console.error/warn` with `logger.error/warn` for notification actions/socket setup. | | frontend/src/hooks/useAutoSave.ts | Reworks draft-save request logic (now using `fetch` + different endpoint/method) and logs flush failures via `logger`. | | frontend/src/hooks/global.ts | Deletes the `useDebounced` hook module. | | frontend/src/hooks/__tests__/useVoiceFavorites.test.ts | Removes a large block of duplicated/older tests, leaving a slimmer test suite. | | frontend/src/components/ui-component/ss-profile/ss-profile.tsx | Removes `React` import and replaces `React.FC` typing with explicit props typing. | | frontend/src/components/ui-component/ss-button/ss-button.tsx | Removes `FC` typing, adds optional `children`, and renders `children ?? text`. | | frontend/src/components/ui-component/floating-chat/floating_chat.component.tsx | Adds `logger` calls for localStorage/chat request failures. |
Suppressed comments (1) **frontend/src/hooks/global.ts:1** * frontend/src/hooks/global.ts (useDebounced) is deleted, but useDebounced is still imported/used in multiple places (e.g., frontend/src/components/post/post.component.tsx, frontend/src/components/dashboard/posts/post_lists.component.tsx, frontend/src/components/dashboard/posts/published_stories.component.tsx, and frontend/src/hooks/tests/useDebounced.test.ts). This will break TypeScript builds and/or tests.

Suppressed comments (2) **frontend/src/hooks/useAutoSave.ts:48** * flushOfflineQueue is exported but its current implementation does not actually flush/drain the provided queue (it never removes items) and provides no rollback behavior on partial failure. I noticed that the Backend and Frontend CI checks are currently failing due to pre-existing TypeScript/merge-conflict errors in unrelated files (e.g. src/app.ts, src/App.tsx, AudioPlayer.tsx, help_sidebar.component.tsx, etc).

I verified my branch against main, and git diff main...HEAD contains only the intended change in frontend/src/redux/apis/writer_application.api.ts ("User" → "user").

I have not modified the unrelated files responsible for the CI failures.

I have implemented the requested fix for Issue #5666.

- Wrapped story node deletion in transaction handling.
- Added safe cascading deletion for child branches.
- Converted foreign key constraint failures into structured HTTP 400 responses.

Kindly review the changes. Thank you!

payload.author: yachikadev
payload.body:
Hi @ronisarkarexe,

I noticed the CI build is currently failing on `main` due to pre-existing TypeScript syntax errors that are unrelated to my changes in this PR. These errors exist in files I haven't touched:

**Backend:**
- `src/app.ts`
- `src/app/modules/story_version/enhance_prompt.utils.ts`
- `src/app/modules/user/user.model.ts`
- `src/controllers/character.controller.ts`

**Frontend:**
- `src/components/stories/stories.component.tsx`
- `src/components/story/StoryWorkspace.tsx`
- `src/hooks/useAutoSave.ts`
- `src/hooks/useSpeechSynthesis.ts`
- `src/utils/truncateText.ts`

The errors look like broken syntax (unterminated template literals, missing brackets, mismatched JSX tags), which suggests these files may have been affected by a prior merge.

I confirmed this is not caused by my changes — I only modified `prompt_analysis.service.ts` and added `guardrails.test.ts`, and pulling latest `main` without my changes still shows the same build failures.

Could you take a look, or let me know if this is already being tracked? Happy to help if needed. Thanks!

None of these is `ContinueStoryButton.tsx`, the only file this PR touches. A plain `npx tsc --noEmit` on `ContinueStoryButton.tsx` alone also passes clean with no errors.

This PR's change (removing the blanket eslint-disable and fixing the `any` type in the catch block) is unaffected by and unrelated to these pre-existing build failures.

payload.author: ritikj17
payload.body:
Hi @ronisarkarexe 

The failing CI checks appear to be unrelated to this PR.

This PR only updates the positioning of `frontend/src/components/ScrollToTopButton.tsx` by changing its bottom spacing (`bottom-24` → `bottom-28`) to prevent the Scroll-to-Top button from overlapping with the floating chatbot button (Fixes #4757).

The failing workflows appear to be caused by existing compilation/build issues in files outside the scope of this change.

As this contribution is part of **GSSoC '26**, I would really appreciate it if this PR could be reviewed when you have the opportunity. If the implementation looks good, I'd be grateful if it could be merged during the program so that the contribution can be counted.

I'm happy to make any requested changes or address feedback.

Thank you!

### CI status note

I reviewed the failing CI checks. The reported failures appear to come from pre-existing repository issues outside the scope of this PR.

- **Backend TypeScript / Build / Typecheck:** failures are reported in existing files such as `app.ts`, `auth.middleware.ts`, `enhance_prompt.utils.ts`, `user.model.ts`, `stripEmojis.ts`, and `character.controller.ts`.

- **Build Pull Request:** fails during the `package.json` validation step with `Invalid JSON in package.json: utf8 is not defined`. This PR does not modify any `package.json` or dependency/lock files.

None of the files reported by these CI failures are modified by this PR.

I have kept this PR scoped specifically to #4485 and have not included unrelated repository-wide fixes.

Hi maintainers! 

Just wanted to clarify that the 3 failing CI build checks are due to pre-existing global build issues in the upstream repository (related to environment errors like `document/window is not defined` in unrelated test suites). 

This PR only introduces two entirely isolated and independent files:
- `truncateText.ts`
- `truncateText.test.ts`

Both files have been fully tested locally and are passing completely. Additionally, all relevant automated checks for this PR—including **Lint**, **Type Check**, and **CodeQL**—have successfully passed ✅. 

Ready for review whenever you have time! 🚀
